# PDF.js 6.4.299

Vendored from the `pdfjs-dist@6.4.299` npm package, published by the Mozilla PDF.js project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js.

`pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs` are the package's minified legacy browser builds. The font, character-map, and WebAssembly resources keep imported PDFs available offline. License files are preserved with the distribution. PDF documents are supplied by the reader and stored privately in IndexedDB; no copyrighted books are bundled here.
